name: Waiting List Applications for Midtown Core Zone Vending License
description: This dataset lists applications on the waiting list for a vending license in the Midtown Core Zone, with 439 sampled records and 12 columns. Each row represents a single waitlist application and includes an application ID, record category, applicant name, blue waitlist number, waitlist status, and selection date. Where an applicant has a related general vendor license, the record also shows the license number, status, and type. Applicant location is captured through city, state, and ZIP code fields. The data can be used to track waitlist demand and queue position, monitor how waitlist status and selection dates change over time, examine the share of applicants who hold general vendor licenses, and analyze the geographic distribution of applicants by city, state, and ZIP code.
prompt:
